test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In January 2022, which state government approved ‘Mana ooru, mana badi’ programme aimed at all round development and creation of effective basic infrastructure in schools across the State?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Telangana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Telangana **government launched **Mana Ooru Mana Badi Scheme on 8th March 2022** for the **development of infrastructure **in schools across the state.
 
• CM KCR has announced that the Mana Ooru Mana Badi Scheme will have three phases in which 9,123 government schools will be renovated with an expenditure of Rs. 3,497.62 crore.
 
• This scheme aims **to give a facelift to government schools across the entire Telangana state. **
 
• The effort is expected to give a major** boost to the education sector in the state.**
 
• **Key Areas under Mana Ooru Mana Badi Scheme:**
 
 
• ​Toilets with running water.
 
• Electrification.
 
• Drinking water.
 
• Furniture for staff and students.
 
• Painting for schools.
 
• Repairs to school buildings.
 
• Construction of new buildings.
 
• Implementation of digital education.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The chief minister of Telangana: **K. Chandrashekar Rao.
 
• **Governor:** Tamilisai Soundararajan.
